frames.title: Your routine order might be backwards.
frames.sub: The Korean rule: thin to thick ↓

frames.title: Watery first
frames.line: Toner or essence right after cleansing.
frames.sub: The lightest texture goes on first.

frames.title: Seal it in
frames.line: Cream last to lock in hydration.

frames.sub: Wait a few seconds between layers.

pin.title: Korean Skincare Layering Order
pin.sub: Thin to thick, step by step

steps.title: Start watery
steps.body: After cleansing, pat on a toner or essence. The lightest, most watery texture always goes first.

steps.title: Build to thick
steps.body: Follow with a serum, then seal everything with a moisturizer. In the morning, finish with sunscreen.

avoid: Putting a heavy cream before a watery serum
Rushing layers without a short pause
Skipping sunscreen as the last morning step
pin.note: Tip: you don't need every step. Two or three thin layers are plenty.
